title: Corr edit sidecar
description: Sidecar next to a media file (MyMovie.mkv → MyMovie.corr.json). Playback currently applies mute and skip; other actions are reserved. Non-length-altering edits (mute) are applied before length-altering edits (skip/cut, and later crop). All times are on the original source timeline and are never adjusted for cuts or crops.

runtime.description: Original source runtime in seconds (not the edited duration).

start.description: Range start in seconds on the original source timeline. Never adjusted for cuts, crops, or other length-changing edits.

end.description: Range end in seconds on the original source timeline; must be greater than start. Never adjusted for cuts, crops, or other length-changing edits.

action.description: Playback applies "mute" and "skip". Other values are ignored until supported.
